text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, solving problems, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every single step. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks, such as recognising images or understanding speech. Today, AI is used in many areas of daily life. For example, it helps with voice assistants, online shopping recommendations, and even medical diagnosis. AI is changing the way we live and work.
